title: Test pointwise P104 defect codes and the code-only update limit
body:
PR3035/3037 establish the fixed P104 lifting word's optimal translation-coset domain, while leaving a noncoset consumer open. This package tests that changed boundary using the exact scaled defect `D_r(x)=2^r L_r(x)−(2^r U_r)x`. Its complete images have **3, 25 and 10,225** values across **4, 64 and 32,768** lattice cosets at ranks 1–3: one fewer fixed label bit at ranks two and three.

The resulting compression fails a precise mutable-source contract. A general written theorem proves that any defect-determining code supporting **every additive source translation from the code alone** must distinguish full defect-period cosets; the coset code attains that abstract minimum. The credited PR3035/3037 period/index premises therefore imply **343 bits at rank seven** for this contract. An explicit repeated witness shows equal pointwise defects separating after translation at every positive rank. This is not a lower bound on immutable-source recomputation, source-dependent/restricted updates, other words or all nonlinear suppliers. No rank-seven pointwise image is enumerated.

The package also gives an exact arbitrary-dirty-buffer consumer for a retained source, and itemizes its two numerator shears, two defect additions, two quotient reads, output/lookup banks and cleanup. The exact wide backend, source/table access, physical movement and full recursive bill remain open. A deliberately specified full-scan XOR-table invoice and a literal rank-one oracle make the cost boundary explicit; scan prices are not circuit lower bounds. **No favorable complete recursive comparison, admitted supplier, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.**

Validation: registered CPython 3.12 replay and nine behavioral groups; direct optimized CPython 3.14 verifier/tests; read-only Git-free export; warnings-as-errors compilation; source and typed-receipt faults; dirty-work/cleanup, signed floor, missing-coverage and source-cache controls. All 32,836 low-rank transversal representatives match the pinned floor word. A separate internal carry-and-rounding specialist independently checks the complete rank-one/two boxes, rederives the all-rank/code/dirty-consumer arguments and reviews the imported maximality proof. Rank three has one implementation with a written complete-transversal proof. No independent human or formal-kernel review; hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-pointwise-defect-consumer
```

Scope is **changed** from the `p104-side-correction` card to PR3043/3046's direct-consumer handoff: a numerical interface obligation of the same P104 cost mechanism. Source PR3035 is pinned at `0cc430349a3f3dc200666bc22e997076e0a557ed` and PR3037 at `02a1c41e8e016d3d0be64c62c8b4734f9c494236`; the source-copy and inverse-context pins are retained in TASK.json. [Open next questions and remaining blockers](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/sprint-20261016T205807Z/research/p104-pointwise-defect-consumer/README.md#open-next-questions).

Only `research/p104-pointwise-defect-consumer/` is added. Scientific base `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority 6/selected record unchanged at the 21:14 UTC refresh. Submission overlap reports complete pagination for 300 open PR bodies including drafts, 1,802 Discussion records and 2,440 closed PR bodies (21:14–21:15 UTC); non-atomic snapshots omit arbitrary diffs and unpublished work. All four named predecessor heads are unchanged. [Canonical finding/claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18982976). Stop at this interface result; the next useful step is one specified retained-source consumer with an actual full tariff, or a source-bound restricted update alphabet.

Credit Tekalign/PR3025/3033, Nick Petalas/PR3035/3037, Ross Richardson/PR3043, Arham Tahir/PR3046, ywz65/PR2586 and the retained P104/native lineage. Exact source commits, Apache-2.0 notices and unchanged proof/code blobs are retained in the package. Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including the separate internal mathematical reviewer. The pair-error identity, lifting word, lattice/maximality and generic lookup are not claimed as new.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

One additive opt-in research package; no shared checker, frozen predecessor, priority or selected record is changed.
